types.name: Find the opening sentence
types.description: Four or five jumbled sentences of a paragraph where the key is spotting the one sentence that can stand alone and introduce the topic (a general statement or definition with no pronoun or connector at the start).

types.name: Pronoun and reference links
types.description: Jumbled sentences of a paragraph where the order is fixed by references: a noun or full name first, then a pronoun (he, it, they, this, such) or the short form, acronym or 'the X' that refers back to it.

types.name: Connectors and time order
types.description: Jumbled sentences of a paragraph or story where the order is fixed by connectors (but, however, therefore, as a result, moreover) or by time words and sequence (first, then, after a year, finally).

types.name: First and last sentences given
types.description: The first and last sentences (S1 and S6, or 1 and 6) are fixed and only the middle sentences labelled P, Q, R, S are to be arranged.

types.name: Parts of one sentence
types.description: Phrases or parts of a single sentence (not full sentences) are given in jumbled order, labelled P, Q, R, S or A to E, to be arranged into one meaningful sentence.
